parameters.name: IncludeRule
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include the health check results for forwarding rules.

- **true**

- **false** (default)

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Range: **1** to **30**. Default: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results.

- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

- For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous response.
